temporal_state_chain.observed: At the mutual patient's funeral, Sara sees Shirley's somber demeanor. Shirley says it has been tough, that she keeps thinking whether more could have been done, and that it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows Shirley cared for the patient and may be affected by the loss, but she is not yet certain how deeply Shirley is struggling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara's suspicion is confirmed: Shirley is deeply affected by the patient's death and is having difficulty letting go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is grieving the patient's death and may be questioning whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort and reassure Shirley, remind her of the good care they provided, and support her through the loss.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara raises the topic of the patient's treatment. Shirley admits she feels responsible and wonders whether pushing for a different approach might have helped. Shirley says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and possibly carrying self-doubt or a burden about the patient's outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Shirley explicitly confirms that she feels responsible and burdened by the treatment outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels responsible for the patient's outcome and is carrying guilt that is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Alleviate Shirley's guilt by reassuring her that they made the best decisions with the information they had and that she should not carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley's continued reserved behavior and minimal emotional expression. In a quiet moment, Sara tells Shirley it is okay to be open. Shirley says she is not sure she can because she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is still grieving and may be suppressing her emotions, possibly because she feels burdened or unsure how to express them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara learns that Shirley's reserve is driven by fear of appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley may be willing to try being more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is holding back her feelings due to fear of judgment, but she is receptive to expressing them more openly among friends.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her emotions and reassure her that it is healthy and safe to do so, especially among friends.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong in their last conversation. Shirley says it was a bit much but that she knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and wants to keep talking because it helps.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes her earlier confrontation may have been too harsh or pressured Shirley, and she may have strained their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara learns Shirley was somewhat taken aback but understood Sara's intent, accepts the apology, and still values their conversations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The apology is accepted. Shirley trusts Sara and wants to keep talking, so the friendship is intact and communication is helpful.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Remorse and apology, shifting toward relief and gratitude.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend the friendship, be available for Shirley in whatever way she needs, and continue supportive conversations.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved. Shirley says she is feeling better thanks to their talks and Sara's support. Shirley agrees to spend more time together outside work and to plan something for the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley has been grieving but that their conversations have been helpful. She is hopeful but not yet certain that Shirley is improving.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara sees and hears that Shirley is feeling better and credits their talks and support. Shirley is also open to spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is improving with support and is willing to deepen their connection outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley, plan a weekend get-together, and maintain their connection outside work.
